text: Khadija - knee op @ St Thomas's May 14. her sister Zara driving her in that morning. text K the day after to see how she's feeling

Rhys viewing 2 flats in Leeds sat - one in Headingley, one by the ring road which he already hates lol. budget tight bc he's still paying off the car. his flatmate Joe might come w/ him, depends if Joe's lease ends in time (Nov 30). said I'd look at the listings w/ him tonight + send any I find
Mihai + Dorota moving to Bristol end of June. she's starting @ the uni there in Sept, he's still remote for the Bucharest lot
gall bladder out - Esme's mum, 6/3. Esme v anxious, only child so it's all on her. ring Esme that evening
bins Tues not Weds this wk. skip collection 10/24
Kai's dad back in hospital (chest infection again). Kai going up to Glasgow tmrw, staying a week after. dont forget to check in w/ him Fri
Aaliyah - new place in Walthamstow!! keys Nov 2nd. housewarming the sat after, need to sort a plant or something for her
Nikolai Petrov aka Nik - cataract surgery Dec 9, other eye in Jan. can't drive for a bit afterwards. offered lifts
Archie & his gf Simone - flat viewing in Peckham went well, offer in. they hear back Mon. ask Archie how it went
Tendai's moving back to Harare in the spring. been 6 yrs here. gutted tbh
hip replacement for Andre's grandad Aug 18th. Andre doing the hospital run that morning + staying over the night before. grandad 89, stubborn as anything
Kasia - wisdom teeth out last thurs, face still huge. soup only. message her this wkend

Dev - house sale fell through AGAIN. chain collapsed, buyer's buyer pulled out on the morning of exchange. v fed up, says he's done w/ estate agents. moving now prob not till new yr, and his wife Aaliyah's due in March so the timing is awful. she's fine, he's the one not sleeping. check in w/ him next wk
Joe's leaving drinks were meant to be Fri - cancelled, he's off sick. rescheduling
Kieran's partner Dong - MRI on 4/22, results a week after. Kieran says he's putting a brave face on but scared. call K the day before

Milan new job in Manchester from Mon - senior designer @ some agency in Ancoats. flat via work for 1st month then has to find his own. he's a big City fan so happy days. his mum's not keen, she's in Coventry on her own now. ask how 1st wk went + whether he's found anywhere
Joseph + Aoife getting the keys to their 1st house May 30th!! card + bottle of fizz. Aoife's parents helping w/ the move the next day
Aurelio - dentist cleaner thing, not op. fine
Ahmed's daughter Zara starting nursery Monday. Ahmed more nervous than she is
Deepa - back from hospital since sun. appendix. off work 4-6 wks. she's bored already, wants book recs. send her the Le Carré list
Hemi's in Wellington till Nov 20, then back via Singapore. his brother Rhys getting married out there Nov 8
Kemal moving in w/ his bf in Lewisham, Jan 1st. needs a van - I said ask Rhys, he's got one
Sunil - colonoscopy 7/11. prep the day before is grim apparently. he's dreading it. text him good luck that morning + see how he is afterwards
Rachel's dog Biscuit had his op (lump removed). all ok. she cried down the phone lol
Keisha - offered the Edinburgh job!! means moving up in Feb. her mum not thrilled. congrats msg
Gintaras - back op postponed again, now Sept 15th. 3rd time. pain bad, can barely sit. must check in next wk
cleaner Thurs 10am. buy bin bags + descaler
Zara says Khadija's op went fine, home Weds. Zara staying w/ her the first few nights
Esme - flat in Brighton, rent going up 200. landlord selling maybe. looking at Hove instead. her cat Pickle hates moving so thats fun
Mihai's bday May 3rd. wants a decent cafetiere - his broke in the move
Rhys got the 2nd flat! moving Oct 28. his mum's coming down from Wrexham to help that wkend. I'm doing the IKEA run w/ him the day before

Kai - his dad discharged yesterday, home w/ carers 2x day. Kai back to London Sun but has to go up again 11/18 for the follow up appt, then again the wk after for the scan. his sister Esme can't help, she's got the twins. he sounds wiped, barely eating. honestly worried about him. take him for a pint when he's back

Andre + Simone - viewing a 2 bed in Croydon 3/9, then another in Sutton the same afternoon. Simone's sister Keisha might go halves on a deposit somewhere eventually. Andre keeps saying 'just renting' but he wants a garden for the dog, Bruno, who's massive. remind me to send them the mortgage broker's number before the viewings
Nikolai - 1st eye done. says colours are mad bright now. 2nd one Jan 13

Kasia's moving to Kraków for a yr w/ work, flies 9/1. her bf Kieran staying here, they're doing long distance. she's nervous re the language even tho her gran's Polish - says she only knows food words. leaving drinks the wk before, prob Aug 24. she wants a decent phrasebook or one of those language app subs as a leaving present apparently
Dorota - fractured wrist, cast for 6 wks. fell on the stairs in the new flat. can't type. Mihai doing everything lol
Archie's offer accepted!! completion Dec 12 ish. his parents chipping in. need to get them a housewarming gift
Dev's nan in hospital w/ pneumonia. he's going up to Durham this wkend. call him Mon
Tendai's leaving do Mar 21st, the Dog & Duck. his wife Keisha flying out ahead w/ the kids Mar 14. he stays behind to pack the house up. I'm sorting the card
Joe - back at work after the flu. leaving drinks now Oct 31

Milan's girlfriend Aoife Kim (not that Aoife) - spinal surgery booked Apr 8th, 5 nights in, then rehab. Milan taking 2 wks off after. she's v scared about the anaesthetic. send flowers the day after + ask Milan what she can eat

Joseph - first night in the new house, boiler broke lol. no hot water, Aoife boiling kettles for a bath. turns out it's under the sellers' warranty so should be free. plumber Weds, then Aoife's dad doing the electrics the day after. they're both exhausted but v happy. Joseph also starts his new job @ the council Mon so it's all happening
Ahmed - Zara loved nursery. cried at pickup bc she didn't want to leave

Aurelio's moving to Lisbon w/ his sister Zara in June. she's got a job out there, he's going to freelance + surf. selling everything - sofa, books, the lot. leaving party June 6th at his. wants rid of his bike - ask if I can have it. also mentioned his knee's been bad again, physio said no running for a month
Deepa back at work Mon, phased return. still tired. lunch w/ her the wk after?
Hemi - Rhys's wedding was amazing, sent pics. Hemi back Thurs
Kemal & Rhys sorted the van thing. move done. Kemal's bf Milan (not Manchester Milan) already redecorating
Sunil - all clear!! polyp was nothing. he's v relieved. beers soon

Rachel moving into her dad's for a bit while he recovers from his stroke. his speech coming back slowly. physio 3x a week. Rachel's brother Sunil does weekends. she's knackered, still working full time. must call her this wk, maybe take dinner round Sat
Keisha - found a flat in Leith, viewing 2/7 on FaceTime. moves 2/20, starts the job 3/1
Gintaras - op finally done 9/15. 3 nights in. walking w/ a frame. his wife Deepa says he's a terrible patient. visit when he's home, prob the wk after
dentist 11/4 2:30. MOT due Dec
Esme's mum home after the op, recovering ok. Esme moving in w/ her for a fortnight. Esme's bf Kai (diff Kai) looking after Pickle
Kieran - Dong's MRI clear!! celebrating Sat

Dong's mum 70 on June 19th. big do in Leicester, whole family flying in from Busan. Kieran + Dong both going, Kieran nervous re meeting all the cousins for the first time. Dong's mum loves orchids + anything from M&S food apparently. Kieran asked if I'd feed their cat Miso that wkend - yes, need the keys off him the day before
Mihai - cafetiere v hint dropped again. also likes that single origin place in Clifton

Simone - surgery on her shoulder 5/14. physio after, 6 wks. Andre says she won't rest. she's also mid job hunt, interview the week after. need to: text her the night before, then check in a few days afterwards
Kasia landed in Kraków! flat is tiny but nice. her bf visiting Oct 2nd for a wk
Joe off to Tenerife w/ his mum after the drinks. back Nov 9
Aaliyah - housewarming was great. her neighbour's cat keeps coming in. she's allergic so not ideal
